verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Square lets sellers accept in-person payments quickly via Tap to Pay on iPhone (no extra hardware needed) and references a dashboard ('Switch to Square', location management) and community commentary that hardware complements the merchant-services core, but there's no concrete evidence of the sign-up/approval workflow, hardware ordering process from the dashboard, or a documented same-week timeline. missing for 10: explicit onboarding/approval flow details, evidence of ordering hardware directly from the dashboard, confirmation of same-week turnaround.
